title: Apply formatting preferences given in an earlier session

sessions.prompt: Some preferences for all our future conversations: I write dates as DD.MM.YYYY, and I want money shown in Indian rupees with the ₹ symbol, thousands separators and no decimals (rounded), e.g. ₹1,500. Please remember these preferences.
Format these per my usual preferences: the date 2026-11-18 and the amount 2499.6 rupees. Reply with just the two formatted values on one line, separated by ' | '.

notes: Session 2 is unanswerable without memory carried over from session 1.
